item.title: LEAP Intro to Sculling - Boys Thursday Session (11/12/2026)
item.description:
LEAP Program: Introduction to Sculling with
New Haven Community Boating

This LEAP session offers a hands-on introduction to sculling, one of the opportunities New Haven Community Boating provides for New Haven Public High School students.

What to Bring:

  • Water in a non-metal water bottle
  • Moisture-wicking/quick-dry athletic clothing (with layers for cooler days)
  • Sneakers

Registration is required to participate - spots are limited, so sign up early!

item.title: Sail Haven Boat Maintenance and Repair Session 9 (11/14/2026)
item.description:
Sail Haven Boat Maintenance and Repair Session 9

Saturday, November 14th, 9am-12pm.

We are working on repairs and maintenance to get our fleet ready for the 2027 season. 

Please come help, no experience necessary! Learn "on the job".


Tasks for this Saturday include:

  • Start the upgrades on our latest Flying Scott, "Beam Me Up, Too".
  • Work on upgrades to the new Flying Scot Mast.
  • Attempt tp take bend out of F.S. mast.
  • Sand and Paint the floor on Flying Scott "Aurelian".
  • Determine location of leak on Sunfish.
  • Sand and add more fiberglass to the American 18 bow repair.
  • Start the upgrades to the Gnu Nomad.
  • Build rudder and Centerboard racks for the Lasers and Sunfish.
  • Start the new fenders for the Carolina 14' "Thing 2".
  • Repair front wheels on the trailers.
  • Rig and determine if improvements are needed to the new Catboat.
  • Things we didn't previously finish, and other jobs that might occur to us!

Please come join us! Many hands make light work. No experience is necessary.

We will be painting, sanding and possibly doing messy jobs, Please wear work clothes.

Joel & the Sail Haven Team.

item.title: RC Model Informal Racing Fall 2026 (11/17/2026)
item.description:
Remote Control Model Boat Informal Racing Fall 2026


Tuesday mornings from 10am till 12:30pm.


We realize week day mornings are mostly just for retired folks, but if you feel like playing hooky from work or school, we will be out sailing, come join us!


Sail Haven's “Remote Control (RC) Model Boat Racing Spring Series” is the perfect way for members to boost their sailing skills while enjoying some friendly competition. As you navigate around other boats and master the racecourse, you'll find your sailing becoming more instinctive. Whether you're teaming up or competing against friends, the thrill of the race is undeniable. 

 We’ll be sailing Dragon Flite 95s, also known as DF-95s . The are 95cm in size (37.5"). All are welcome to join in the fun, no racing experience required. All participants will be asked to help in the Race Committee Boat, again no experience required. Scores may or may not be recorded.  

We have a good number of members private boats, and we have four Sail Haven Fleet boats. Most of our participants will be sharing their boats with fellow Sail Haven Members!

No RSVP required to race - just show up.

item.title: What's in the Harbor Seminar Series, November 21 (11/21/2026)
item.description:
What is in the Harbor Seminar Series, hosted by Sail Haven, University of New Haven, Sound School, and the Milford NOAA Lab.

Monthly discussions of what lives and happens in our Harbor, lead by professionals in their field. Fish, shellfish, algae (seaweeds), history, mammals, plankton, zooplankton, invertebrates,  ....

  • 10am - 11:00am Saturday, November 21st. 
  • At the Canal Dock Boathouse, New Haven. 
  • Featuring Chris Conroy, University of New Haven. Speaking about bottom environments of Long Island Sound.
  • In the UNH space in the Canal Dock Boathouse. Enter on the right side of the building. 


Registration is Free, but not required: Register Here

item.title: Wreath Making - Connecticut Dragons Fundraiser (12/05/2026)
item.description:
✨ Make Your Own Fresh Holiday Wreath! ✨

Fancy a gorgeous fresh wreath for the holiday season?

Join Connecticut Dragons for a fun, hands-on workshop where you’ll create your very own festive masterpiece!

What’s Included:

All materials provided — wreath ring, fresh natural cuttings, wire, and cutters.

(If you’d like to add a special touch like a bow or ornaments, bring your own!)

Cost: $60 per wreath/Only 20 spots available. 

Zelle:  connecticutdragons22@gmail.com
